description: This file defines Venice AI models, including static catalog data, functions for building model definitions, and a model discovery mechanism that fetches model info from an API with fallback to static data. It also includes error handling and utility functions related to model capabilities and API responses.

classes.name: VeniceDiscoveryHttpError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling HTTP errors during Venice model discovery.

methods.name: staticVeniceModelDefinitions
methods.description: Returns static list of model definitions based on the catalog.

methods.name: hasRetryableNetworkCode
methods.description: Checks if an error contains a network code that is retryable.

methods.name: isRetryableVeniceDiscoveryError
methods.description: Determines if an error is retryable during Venice model discovery.

methods.name: normalizePositiveInt
methods.description: Converts a value to a positive integer or returns undefined.

methods.name: resolveApiMaxCompletionTokens
methods.description: Resolves the maximum number of tokens for API responses, considering model specs and known max tokens.

methods.name: resolveApiSupportsTools
methods.description: Determines if the API model supports tools based on its capabilities.

methods.name: buildVeniceModelDefinition
methods.description: Creates a ModelDefinitionConfig object from a catalog entry.

methods.name: discoverVeniceModels
methods.description: Fetches model data from Venice API with retries and fallback to static catalog if needed.
